title: Sales by Category shows the same two empty states
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Reports — Page Access'.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports › Sales by Category.
  2. Pick a custom date range in a month next year.
  3. Pick This month in the Date filter.
  4. Untick both options in the Sales Type filter.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales by Category opens.

Step 2:

  • It reads "There are no results for selected date range" with no Totals row.

Step 3:

  • This month's rows show again.

Step 4:

  • It reads "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results." with Clear All Filters, and no Totals row.
